title: Order where you see noise
label: A field of drifting blobs drawn as 1-bit ink stipple, meaning not yet understood. A magnifying lens wanders across it; inside the lens every blob is filled in its class colour, outlined and labelled with a confidence, and a trail of coloured stipple fades behind it.
heading:
Order where
you see noise.
sub: Point it at the pile. Every blur of maybe becomes a labelled class, with a confidence you can check.
